title: The Fate of Trump's Financial Records

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻通讯《DealBook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能锁定收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: David, tell us the story behind these three cases, all related to the president's financial records that reached the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 大卫，给我们讲讲这三起案件背后的故事，它们都与提交给最高法院的总统财务记录有关。

sentences.en: So this story starts back in 2015 with a decision by presidential candidate Donald Trump not to do something.
sentences.zh: 这个故事要追溯到2015年，当时总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普决定不做一件事。

sentences.en: For decades,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，

sentences.en: there's a tradition among major presidential candidates to release their tax returns so that the public can understand better the finances of the people they might elect.
sentences.zh: 主要总统候选人一直有一个传统，即公布他们的纳税申报表，以便公众能够更好地了解他们可能选出的这些人的财务状况。

sentences.en: So Carter did this.
sentences.zh: 卡特这样做了。

sentences.en: Reagan, Bush, Clinton, Bush number two did it.
sentences.zh: 里根、布什、克林顿、老布什都这样做了。

sentences.en: Obama did it.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马这样做了。

sentences.en: And hopefully I'm not forgetting anyone there.
sentences.zh: 希望我没有漏掉谁。

sentences.en: But Trump refused to do so, saying that he was under IRS audit.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普拒绝这样做，声称他正在接受国税局的审计。

sentences.en: Every year they audit me, audit me, audit me.
sentences.zh: 他们每年都审计我，审计我，审计我。

sentences.en: And it just wasn't going to be possible.
sentences.zh: 这根本不可能做到。

sentences.en: I will absolutely give my return, but I'm being audited now, so I can't do it until the audit is finished, obviously.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会提供我的纳税申报表，但我现在正在接受审计，所以我做不到，显然要等到审计结束以后。

sentences.en: And I think people would understand that.
sentences.zh: 我想大家会理解这一点的。

sentences.en: This immediately raises a slew of questions in the public and in the media about what's going on in Trump's finances.
sentences.zh: 这立即在公众和媒体中引发了一连串关于特朗普财务状况的疑问。

sentences.en: He is someone who, among major presidential candidates in recent decades, is probably unique in terms of the number and gravity of the entanglements he has.
sentences.zh: 在近几十年来的主要总统候选人中，他所面临的纠葛的数量和严重性可能是独一无二的。

sentences.en: He's been running for decades this multifaceted business that has operations and assets all over the world.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，他一直在经营这项多方位的业务，其运营和资产遍布全球。

sentences.en: And so his refusal to release even basic financial information about himself,
sentences.zh: 因此，他甚至拒绝公布关于他自己的基本财务信息，

sentences.en: it raises a lot of suspicion about whether this presidential candidate has something in his finances that he is trying to hide.
sentences.zh: 这引发了人们的强烈怀疑：这位总统候选人的财务状况中是否有什么不可告人的秘密。

sentences.en: Do you believe voters have a right to see your tax returns before they make a final decision?
sentences.zh: 你认为选民在做出最后决定之前有权查看你的纳税申报表吗？

sentences.en: I don't think they do, but I do say this.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们没有，但我确实这么说。

sentences.en: When the audit ends, I'm going to present them.
sentences.zh: 当审计结束时，我会把它们呈交出来。

sentences.en: That should be before the election.
sentences.zh: 那应该是在选举之前。

sentences.en: I hope it's before the election.
sentences.zh: 我希望是在选举之前。

sentences.en: And then, of course, he gets elected without ever having released his tax returns.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，他在从未公布纳税申报表的情况下当选了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And remind us, what begins to change all this?
sentences.zh: 提醒一下我们，是什么开始改变这一切的？

sentences.en: Well, two things happen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，发生了两件事。

sentences.en: The first is that in the fall of 2018, the New York Times drops this massive investigation into the Trump family's finances.
sentences.zh: 首先是2018年秋天，《纽约时报》发表了这篇关于特朗普家族财务状况的大规模调查报告。

sentences.en: And one of the things it reveals is that Donald Trump and others committed what looks like fraud in an effort to reduce the amount that they owe in taxes.
sentences.zh: 其中揭露的一件事是，唐纳德·特朗普和其他人实施了看似欺诈的行为，企图减少他们欠下的税款。

sentences.en: So that really intensifies the clamor to get a better understanding of what's going on inside the Trump finances.
sentences.zh: 这真正加剧了人们的呼声，希望能更好地了解特朗普财务内部发生的事情。

sentences.en: The second thing that happens is that in November of 2018, Democrats regain control of the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 发生的第二件事是，在2018年11月，民主党重新夺回了众议院的控制权。

sentences.en: And that means that two of the most powerful congressional committees are now going to be controlled by Democrats instead of Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这意味着两个最有权势的国会委员会将由民主党而不是共和党控制。

sentences.en: And in particular, they're going to be controlled by two of Trump's loudest critics on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 特别是，它们将由国会山上特朗普最直言不讳的两个批评者所控制。

sentences.en: When he says, we had no contact with the Russians, that's a lie.
sentences.zh: 当他说我们与俄罗斯人没有任何接触时，那是谎言。

sentences.en: When his son says, I had no contacts with WikiLeaks, that's a lie.
sentences.zh: 当他的儿子说我与维基解密没有任何接触时，那是谎言。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, the list goes on and on.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这样的例子不胜枚举。

sentences.en: Adam Schiff will be the chairman of the House Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 亚当·希夫将担任众议院情报委员会主席。

sentences.en: He refuses to turn over the tax returns.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝交出纳税申报表。

sentences.en: What does he have to hide?
sentences.zh: 他有什么好隐瞒的？

sentences.en: And Maxine Waters will be chairman of the House Financial Services Committee.
sentences.zh: 而玛克辛·沃特斯将担任众议院金融服务委员会主席。

sentences.en: Has he been compromised in any way?
sentences.zh: 他是否在任何方面受到了妥协？

sentences.en: Is there money laundering going on?
sentences.zh: 是否存在洗钱行为？

sentences.en: And they make very clear, very early on, that one of their priorities in this new Congress is going to be to launch major investigations of Donald Trump and his financial dealings.
sentences.zh: 他们在很早的时候就非常明确地表示，他们在这个新国会中的首要任务之一就是对唐纳德·特朗普及其金融交易展开重大调查。

sentences.en: There is enough that we know about him to have legitimate suspicion, and we need to have documentation.
sentences.zh: 我们对他的了解已经足够产生合理的怀疑，我们需要有文件证明。

sentences.en: And it becomes very clear very quickly that one of the weapons that the congressional Democrats investigators plan to use is to subpoena as much information as they can,
sentences.zh: 非常快地，这就变得非常明确：国会民主党调查人员计划使用的武器之一，就是尽可能多地传唤信息，

sentences.en: not from Trump himself, but from the financial institutions that he has done business with over the years.
sentences.zh: 不是来自特朗普本人，而是来自他多年来一直在与之进行业务往来的金融机构。

sentences.en: And why are they interested in those financial institutions?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们对这些金融机构感兴趣？

sentences.en: Well, it's much easier for them to pry information out of a third party than it is to pry it out of Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从第三方那里套取信息比从特朗普本人那里套取信息要容易得多。

sentences.en: Among other things, Trump has shown over the years to not put a whole lot of stock in adhering to things like subpoenas or court orders.
sentences.zh: 除其他事项外，特朗普多年来表现出对遵守传票或法院命令之类的事情并不怎么放在心上。

sentences.en: He delays, he kicks the can down the road as much as he can.
sentences.zh: 他会拖延，能拖多久就尽量拖延。

sentences.en: So there are two financial institutions in particular.
sentences.zh: 因此，特别有两家金融机构。

sentences.en: One is Mazars, which is an accounting firm that has prepared that Trump's taxes over the years.
sentences.zh: 一个是马扎尔会计师事务所，这是一家多年来一直为特朗普准备税表的会计事务所。

sentences.en: And the other is Deutsche Bank, which is the lender that has provided billions of dollars in loans and other services to Trump and his family over the past two decades.
sentences.zh: 另一个是德意志银行，这是一家在过去二十年里向特朗普及其家人提供数十亿美元贷款和其他服务的贷款机构。

sentences.en: And David, what was the legal rationale for these congressional committees to subpoena these documents?
sentences.zh: 大卫，这些国会委员会传唤这些文件的法律依据是什么？

sentences.en: Because I imagine the subpoenas had to relate to the work of these committees.
sentences.zh: 因为我想象传票必须与这些委员会的工作相关。

sentences.en: It depends whom you ask.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你问谁。

sentences.en: This needs to be looked into because if there's a financial leverage that the Russians hold over Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这需要进行调查，因为俄罗斯人对唐纳德·特朗普拥有财务杠杆。

sentences.en: In the case of the Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 就情报委员会而言。

sentences.en: That could warp our policy in ways that are not in our national intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这可能会以不符合我们国家利益的方式扭曲我们的政策。

sentences.en: It was conducting an investigation into foreign interference in the 2016 presidential election.
sentences.zh: 它正在对2016年总统选举中的外国干预进行调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so their argument was that if there is evidence inside Deutsche Bank's vault.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的论点是，如果德意志银行的保险库里有证据。

sentences.en: If the president is claiming no business dealings with Russia while he's trying to make this Trump Tower deal take place,
sentences.zh: 如果总统在试图促成特朗普大厦交易的同时声称与俄罗斯没有业务往来，

sentences.en: has he also been concealing money laundering with Russians?
sentences.zh: 他是否也一直在隐瞒与俄罗斯人的洗钱活动？

sentences.en: Of Trump being in business with Russians or owing money to Russians or being involved in money laundering with Russians?
sentences.zh: 特朗普与俄罗斯人做生意、欠俄罗斯人钱，或者卷入与俄罗斯人的洗钱活动？

sentences.en: That's some serious business that we need to look into.
sentences.zh: 这是一些我们需要调查的严重事情。

sentences.en: We need to follow the money.
sentences.zh: 我们需要顺藤摸瓜。

sentences.en: That was very relevant to the committee's investigation of the Russian interference in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 这与委员会对2016年大选俄罗斯干预事件的调查高度相关。

sentences.en: With the House Financial Services Committee, the legal rationale was a little bit murkier.
sentences.zh: 对于众议院金融服务委员会而言，法律依据则有些模糊不清。

sentences.en: And, of course, he has a reputation for everything from filing bankruptcies to cheating people.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，他从申请破产到欺骗他人都有着不好的名声。

sentences.en: The argument that they made was that this was part of a broader investigation by the committee
sentences.zh: 他们提出的论点是，这是委员会更广泛调查的一部分，

sentences.en: into the soundness and propriety of the financial system overall and the banking system overall.
sentences.zh: 即对整个金融体系以及整个银行业务的稳健性和合规性的调查。

sentences.en: To basically being involved with the Russians and other foreign entities.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是卷入了与俄罗斯和其他外国实体的关系。

sentences.en: And so there's a lot there.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有很多内容。

sentences.en: And so their argument was that it was highly relevant to figure out if a major financial institution was engaged in wrongdoing
sentences.zh: 因此他们的论点是，弄清楚一家主要金融机构是否参与了违法行为具有高度相关性，

sentences.en: as it related to the bank accounts of one of the most powerful people in the world.
sentences.zh: 因为这与世界上最有权势的人之一的银行账户有关。

sentences.en: And the reality is that these also had a real tinge of politics.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，这些也带有了浓厚的政治色彩。

sentences.en: Maxine Waters and Adam Schiff are two of the most outspoken critics of Donald Trump and his administration on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 玛克辛·沃特斯和亚当·希夫是国会山上对唐纳德·特朗普及其政府最直言不讳的两个批评者。

sentences.en: And I think it is quite hard to escape the reality that they were looking for dirt on the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为很难回避这样一个现实：他们是在寻找总统的黑料。

sentences.en: And one of the dirtiest things to look at in their mind was his finances.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，最见不得人的事情之一就是他的财务状况。

sentences.en: Because Trump had kept them such a tightly held secret.
sentences.zh: 因为特朗普把这些保密得严严实实。

sentences.en: And if there wasn't anything bad to see, Trump presumably would have released his tax returns and been much more transparent about this from the get-go.
sentences.zh: 如果没有什么不好的东西可看，特朗普想必早就公布了他的纳税申报表，并在这一问题上一开始就更加透明。

sentences.en: And so what is the president's response to these congressional subpoenas?
sentences.zh: 那么总统对这些国会传票作何回应？

sentences.en: The president's response...
sentences.zh: 总统的回应是……

sentences.en: ...suing two of the banks that helped build their family empire...
sentences.zh: ……起诉了两家帮助建立其家族帝国的银行……

sentences.en: ...is to sue.
sentences.zh: ……就是起诉。

sentences.en: The president's attorneys are trying to circumvent anything the banks would provide to Congress, saying, quote, the subpoenas were issued to harass President Donald J.
sentences.zh: 总统的律师正试图规避银行可能向国会提供的任何信息，他们声称：“传票的发出是为了骚扰唐纳德·J·特朗普总统，为了翻遍他个人财务的方方面面……”

sentences.en: Trump, to rummage through every aspect of his personal finances...
sentences.zh: 因此，他和他的家人向联邦法院起诉了德意志银行和马扎尔会计师事务所，试图阻止它们遵守这些国会传票。

sentences.en: So he goes to federal court with his family and files lawsuits against Deutsche Bank, against Mazars, seeking to block them from complying with these congressional subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 也就是阻止它们将他的记录移交给国会。

sentences.en: So block them from handing over his records to Congress.
sentences.zh: 特朗普家族提出的论点大致有两个方面。

sentences.en: And the argument that the Trump family makes is kind of twofold.
sentences.zh: 一是这些传票没有立法或法律目的。

sentences.en: One is that there's no legislative or legal purpose to these subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 这相当于国会山上的政治捕鱼式执法，实际上没有任何正当的理由。

sentences.en: This amounts to a political fishing expedition on Capitol Hill and doesn't actually have any proper rationale.
sentences.zh: 第二个论点基本上归结为权力分立的主张，

sentences.en: And the second argument essentially boils down to a separation of powers claim,
sentences.zh: 即总统没有暴露于、或者说不应该暴露于国会对他的个人事务进行无休止的干预之中。

sentences.en: which is that the president is not exposed or should not be exposed to endless congressional meddling in his personal affairs.
sentences.zh: 因此，在该家族提起这些诉讼后，联邦法院基本上按下了暂停键，暂停了任何人真正执行这些传票的行动。

sentences.en: So after the family files these lawsuits, federal courts basically hit pause on anyone actually enforcing these subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些案件进入了联邦法院系统，并在接下来的的一年里，逐渐上诉到了最高法院。

sentences.en: And so the cases go into the federal court system and gradually, over the next year, work their way up to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就解释了提交给最高法院的三起案件中的两起。

sentences.en: Okay, so that accounts for two of the three cases before the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 特朗普诉马扎尔会计师事务所案，即他的会计师事务所。

sentences.en: Trump versus Mazars, his accounting firm.
sentences.zh: 特朗普诉德意志银行案，即他的银行。

sentences.en: Trump versus Deutsche Bank, his bank.
sentences.zh: 我想这还剩下一个案子，对吧？

sentences.en: And I think that leaves us with one more case, right?
sentences.zh: 没，错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 那个案子涉及曼哈顿地区检察官赛·万斯。

sentences.en: And that case involves the Manhattan District Attorney, Cy Vance.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 因此，在这些国会传票在联邦法院进行诉讼的同时，

sentences.en: So at the same time that these congressional subpoenas are being litigated in federal court,
sentences.zh: 赛·万斯的办公室对特朗普及其公司展开了刑事调查。

sentences.en: Cy Vance's office opens up a criminal investigation into Trump and his company.
sentences.zh: 这项调查的焦点是斯托米·丹尼尔斯。

sentences.en: And this investigation is focused on Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 我是谁？

sentences.en: Who am I?
sentences.zh: 我是。

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 还记得她吗？

sentences.en: Remember her?
sentences.zh: 我是斯托米。

sentences.en: I am Stormy.
sentences.zh: 她就是那个据称与特朗普有染的色情明星。

sentences.en: She is the porn star with whom Trump was allegedly having an affair.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯和特朗普的前私人律师迈克尔·科恩表示，他们基本上是花钱让斯托米·丹尼尔斯保持沉默。

sentences.en: And what Stormy Daniels and Michael Cohen, Trump's former personal lawyers, say is that they basically paid Stormy Daniels to keep quiet.
sentences.zh: 他们在2016年大选前夕向她提供了封口费。

sentences.en: They provided hush money payments to her in the prelude to the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 赛·万斯和其他人一直在调查的问题是，这些付款本质上是否构成了竞选支出，以及这是否构成了未公开的、因而违反联邦竞选财务法的行为。

sentences.en: And the issue that Cy Vance and others have been looking into here is whether those payments constituted essentially campaign spending and whether that was an undisclosed and therefore violation of federal campaign finance laws.
sentences.zh: 因此，赛·万斯不仅开始调查这个问题，

sentences.en: So Cy Vance starts investigating not only this issue,
sentences.zh: 还调查了特朗普组织内部以及特朗普个人财务内部的一系列其他潜在财务违规行为。

sentences.en: but also just a whole series of other potential financial improprieties inside of the Trump organization and inside Trump's personal finances as well.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，赛·万斯的办公室向马扎尔会计师事务所——即被国会民主党人传唤的那家会计师事务所——发出了传票，

sentences.en: And so as part of that, Cy Vance's office issues a subpoena to Mazars, the accounting firm, the same one that's been subpoenaed by congressional Democrats,
sentences.zh: 要求获得特朗普总统八年的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: and seeks eight years of President Trump's tax returns.
sentences.zh: 我认为，赛·万斯办公室的希望是，这将有助于揭开不仅是特朗普的银行账户，还有他的公司的内部运作情况，

sentences.en: And the hope from Cy Vance's office, I think, is that that will shed some light on the inner workings of not just Trump's bank accounts, but also his company,
sentences.zh: 并且它可能会揭露一些具有潜在破坏性的信息。

sentences.en: and it could reveal some of the potentially damaging information.
sentences.zh: 因此，与具有某种立法理由的国会传票不同，曼哈顿地区检察官的这份传票具有刑事调查的理由。

sentences.en: So unlike the congressional subpoenas, which have a kind of legislative rationale, this subpoena from the District Attorney of Manhattan, it has a criminal investigatory rationale.
sentences.zh: 是的，没，错。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 这是一项刑事调查，这是一份发给马扎尔的刑事传票。

sentences.en: This is a criminal investigation, and this is a criminal subpoena that goes to Mazars.
sentences.zh: 就在传票发出后不久，特朗普对地区检察官办公室提起了诉讼，

sentences.en: And very soon after the subpoena is issued, Trump files a lawsuit against the District Attorney's office,
sentences.zh: 辩称赛·万斯根本没有法定权力对总统进行刑事调查。

sentences.en: arguing that Cy Vance simply does not have the legal authority to conduct a criminal investigation of the president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的论点是，现任总统享有豁免权，不受此类刑事调查。

sentences.en: Trump's argument is that the sitting president is immune from this kind of criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个案件以及涉及国会传票的两个案件，开始在联邦法院系统中审理，并最终提交给最高法院，

sentences.en: So this case, along with the two involving the congressional subpoenas, they start working their way through the federal court system and eventually land before the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在的处境。

sentences.en: which is where we are now.
sentences.zh: 这些案件的利害关系非常非常重大。

sentences.en: And the stakes here with these cases are really, really high.
sentences.zh: 归根结底就是，公众是否有权了解其当选领导人的财务状况？

sentences.en: And really, it boils down to, does the public have the right to know about the finances of its elected leaders?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 特朗普家族的论点是，答案是否定的。

sentences.en: And the Trump family's argument is that the answer to that is no.
sentences.zh: 公众无权知晓。

sentences.en: The public doesn't have the right to know.
sentences.zh: 这些国会委员会无权知晓。

sentences.en: These congressional committees don't have the right to know.
sentences.zh: 甚至连地区检察官或检察官也无权知晓，即使在像这样的刑事调查中也是如此。

sentences.en: And not even district attorneys or prosecutors have the right to know, not even in a criminal investigation such as this one.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，

sentences.en: And on the flip side,
sentences.zh: 民主党人、检察官以及相当多其他人则认为，了解你选出的领导人的财务利益的权利，绝对是你决定你的总统的利益是否与公众利益正确一致的核心所在。

sentences.en: the Democrats and the prosecutors and quite a few others argue that the right to know about your elected leader's financial interests is absolutely core to your ability to determine whether your president's interests are properly aligned with the public's interests.
sentences.zh: 民主党人、检察官以及相当多的其他人认为，了解您所选出的领导人的财务利益的权利，对于您判断总统的利益是否与公众利益真正一致至关重要。

sentences.en: And the only way to really know that is have a clear understanding of what the president's financial interests are.
sentences.zh: 要真正了解这一点的唯一方法，就是清楚地知道总统的财务利益到底是什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And those are the theoretically lofty questions at hand here.
sentences.zh: 而这些就是这里手头那些理论上很高深的问题。

sentences.en: But to flip it around, isn't another version of these three cases whether or not a president is entitled to some kind of legal privacy,
sentences.zh: 但反过来说，这三个案件的另一种版本，难道不是关于总统是否有权享有某种法律隐私吗？

sentences.en: especially when people seeking his personal financial records have a documented political agenda?
sentences.zh: 特别是当那些寻求他的个人财务记录的人有着公开的政治意图时？

sentences.en: Yeah, and there's no question that there are politics at play here.
sentences.zh: 是的，毫无疑问这里面存在政治因素。

sentences.en: So I think that's a fair point to make, and it's certainly the point that the Trump family is making.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得提出这一点很合理，这当然也是特朗普家族正在提出的观点。

sentences.en: I think in practical terms, though, putting aside all of the issues about separation of powers and presidential powers, practically there is a very important issue at play here,
sentences.zh: 不过我认为从实际角度来看，抛开所有关于权力分立和总统权力的争议不谈，实际上这里有一个非常重要的问题，

sentences.en: which is there is a lot of very detailed,
sentences.zh: 那就是，有大量非常详细、

sentences.en: very sensitive information sitting inside Mazars and sitting inside Deutsche Bank that the congressional Democrats and Cy Vance have demanded.
sentences.zh: 非常敏感的信息存放在玛扎尔会计师事务所和德意志银行，这是国会民主党人和赛·万斯一直要求的。

sentences.en: And if that information does get handed over,
sentences.zh: 如果这些信息真的被交出去，

sentences.en: it could really provide a startling inside glimpse inside these highly secretive companies' operations and the president's kind of innermost financial secrets.
sentences.zh: 它确实可能会让人大开眼界，一窥这些高度保密公司的运营情况以及总统内心深处的财务秘密。

sentences.en: And, of course, this brings us to Thursday and to the Supreme Court finally making a decision in these three cases.
sentences.zh: 当然，这就把我们带到了周四，以及最高法院终于对这三个案件做出裁决的那一刻。

sentences.en: Yeah, and this is a really big day.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实是个非常重大的日子。

sentences.en: I mean, I've been waiting for this day for as long as I can remember, I feel like.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我感觉自己从记事起就一直在等待这一天。

sentences.en: And the stakes, as we said, are really high.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，利害关系确实非常重大。

sentences.en: There's these huge, important questions of presidential power and the rights of Congress to investigate.
sentences.zh: 这里涉及关于总统权力和国会调查权的巨大而重要的问题。

sentences.en: And at the same time, this is happening four months before the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这件事发生在距离总统大选还有四个月的时候。

sentences.en: So this is really the last chance that the media and the public will have to get a glimpse of Donald Trump's innermost financial secrets before Election Day.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是媒体和公众在大选日前最后一次机会，得以一窥唐纳德·特朗普内心深处的财务秘密。

sentences.en: So it's really, really hard to overstate the importance of Thursday's decision.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论怎么强调周四裁决的重要性都不为过。

sentences.en: David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So, Adam Liptak, our colleague David Enrich just walked us through the origins of these three cases before the court.
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当·利普塔克，我们的同事大卫·恩里奇刚刚为我们梳理了这三个提交到法院审理的案件的起源。

sentences.en: So how did the Supreme Court decide?
sentences.zh: 那么最高法院是怎么裁决的呢？

sentences.en: Michael, it was a bit of a split decision.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这是一个有点分裂的裁决。

sentences.en: The court adopted a lot of what the president had to say in one set of cases and rejected his main argument in the other case.
sentences.zh: 法院在一组案件中很大程度上接纳了总统的说法，而在另一组案件中驳回了他的主要论点。

sentences.en: Okay, I wonder if we can start with the bucket of cases related to Congress, these congressional subpoenas of the president's financial records.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想请问我们能否从与国会相关的那批案件开始，也就是国会传唤总统财务记录的这些案子？

sentences.en: What did the court decide in those cases?
sentences.zh: 法院在这些案件中做出了什么裁决？

sentences.en: The court decided that this was a novel issue implicating the separation of powers.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定，这是一个涉及权力分立的新问题。

sentences.en: It was hesitant to do anything particularly bold.
sentences.zh: 它对采取任何特别大胆的举措感到犹豫。

sentences.en: And it thought that lower courts should take a fresh look at the question of whether the congressional committees had given adequate reasons for seeking vast troves of material and whether they had shown that they truly had a legislative need for them.
sentences.zh: 它认为下级法院应该以全新的视角重新审视这样一个问题：国会委员会在寻求海量材料时是否给出了充分的理由，以及他们是否证明了自己确实有立法的必要性。

sentences.en: And specifically, what did the justices have to say about the rationale Congress cited that documents like these relate to their work as Congress?
sentences.zh: 具体来说，大法官们对国会引用的理由是怎么看的？比如这些文件与他们作为国会的工作相关？

sentences.en: It would inform, you know, an investigation into Russia.
sentences.zh: 这会为针对俄罗斯的调查提供信息，你知道的。

sentences.en: It would inform an understanding of the tax system.
sentences.zh: 这会有助于理解税收系统。

sentences.en: The court did seem to suggest that the House's argument was so broad that it could be a phishing expedition for all kinds of things, including personal emails,
sentences.zh: 法院确实暗示众议院的论点范围太广了，以至于可能成为对各种事情的钓鱼执法，包括个人电子邮件，

sentences.en: that the House hadn't really offered a limiting principle for why it's entitled to all the stuff it sought.
sentences.zh: 而且众议院并没有真正提供一个限制性原则，来解释为什么它有权获得它所寻求的所有这些东西。

sentences.en: And the truth is, it sought quite a lot of information.
sentences.zh: 事实是，它寻求的信息量相当巨大。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so to be clear, this means that Congress will not be getting its hands on these records for a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以明确地说，这意味着国会在很长一段时间内都无法拿到这些记录。

sentences.en: Well, it goes back to the lower courts and litigation takes months and months and the election will come and go and a new House of Representatives will be sworn in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这要发回下级法院，而诉讼需要花费几个月又几个月的时间，大选将转瞬即逝，新一届众议院也将宣誓就职。

sentences.en: So it may be that as a practical matter, this shuts down this particular set of subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 所以从实际情况来看，这可能会终结这组特定的传票。

sentences.en: Okay, so that brings us to the second bucket,
sentences.zh: 好的，这就把我们带到了第二类案件，

sentences.en: this case involving a criminal investigation from the Manhattan District Attorney and his subpoena of these financial records in pursuit of that criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 这个涉及曼哈顿地区检察官的刑事调查以及他为进行该刑事调查而对这些财务记录发出的传票的案件。

sentences.en: How did the justices rule in that case?
sentences.zh: 大法官们对该案是如何裁决的？

sentences.en: In that case, the justices squarely rejected President Trump's central argument.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，大法官们毫不含糊地驳回了特朗普总统的核心论点。

sentences.en: He had said that he is categorically and absolutely immune from being investigated by state prosecutors while he remains in office.
sentences.zh: 他曾声称，只要他还在任，他就绝对且完全免受州检察官的调查。

sentences.en: And Chief Justice Roberts, who wrote the majority opinion in both cases, was having none of that.
sentences.zh: 而首席大法官罗伯茨——他在两个案件中都撰写了多数意见书——对这种说法根本不买账。

sentences.en: And what was his legal logic for rejecting that claim by the president?
sentences.zh: 他驳回总统这一主张的法律逻辑是什么？

sentences.en: The chief justice said there was lots of precedent.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官表示，有大量的先例可循。

sentences.en: Going back to the treason trial of Aaron Burr, where there was a subpoena for Thomas Jefferson's information.
sentences.zh: 可以追溯到亚伦·伯尔的叛国罪审判，当时有一张传票要求提供托马斯·杰斐逊的信息。

sentences.en: The Nixon tapes case, where Nixon was made to give up tape recordings of Oval Office conversations.
sentences.zh: 尼克松录音带案，当时迫使尼克松交出了椭圆形办公室对话的录音。

sentences.en: The Clinton against Jones case, where Bill Clinton was made to provide information in a sexual harassment case.
sentences.zh: 克林顿诉琼斯案，当时迫使比尔·克林顿在性骚扰案件中提供信息。

sentences.en: The chief justice said the idea that presidents are above the law in that sense was nonsense.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官表示，总统在那种意义上凌驾于法律之上的想法纯属无稽之谈。

sentences.en: So in the case of the district attorney, he will be getting the records he requested from Trump's accounting firm.
sentences.zh: 所以，在地区检察官的案件中，他将从特朗普的会计事务所获得他所要求的记录。

sentences.en: Well, let's not get ahead of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们别高兴得太早。

sentences.en: It certainly clears the way for the Manhattan district attorney to seek the records.
sentences.zh: 这确实为曼哈顿地区检察官寻求这些记录扫清了道路。

sentences.en: The chief justice said, and this is unexceptional, that as with anyone else who's subpoenaed, he can interpose the usual objections.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官表示——这很常规——就像任何收到传票的人一样，他可以提出通常的反对意见。

sentences.en: The subpoena doesn't seek relevant material.
sentences.zh: 传票寻求的材料不相关。

sentences.en: The subpoena is meant to harass me.
sentences.zh: 传票意在骚扰我。

sentences.en: The subpoena is too burdensome.
sentences.zh: 传票负担过重。

sentences.en: And that may take some time to litigate.
sentences.zh: 而这些可能需要花一些时间来进行诉讼。

sentences.en: I don't think the president's chances in New York courts are particularly good.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统在纽约法院的胜算并不是特别大。

sentences.en: But that part of the decision may, as with the congressional subpoenas, kick this can down the road past the election and maybe much longer.
sentences.zh: 但裁决的这一部分可能会像国会传票一样，把这个皮球踢到大选之后，甚至可能更久。

sentences.en: So this victory for the district attorney of New York, this defeat for President Trump, is not likely to result in those records becoming public.
sentences.zh: 所以，纽约地区检察官的这场胜利、特朗普总统的这次失败，不太可能导致这些记录被公之于众。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So there's a school of thought that President Trump was a winner in both decisions.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种观点认为，特朗普总统在两项裁决中都是赢家。

sentences.en: If his goal was to keep stuff secret for a while longer, he was a winner.
sentences.zh: 如果他的目标是将材料再保密一段时间，他就是个赢家。

sentences.en: If his goal was to have the court adopt his sweeping view of presidential power, he was a loser.
sentences.zh: 如果他的目标是让法院采纳他关于总统权力的极端观点，他就是个输家。

sentences.en: So Adam, I want to square this decision on Thursday with what David Enrich said were the stakes in this case.
sentences.zh: 所以亚当，我想将周四的这一裁决与大卫·恩里奇所说的本案利害关系结合起来权衡一下。

sentences.en: And the first question is, is the public entitled to financial transparency from our president?
sentences.zh: 第一个问题是，公众是否有权从我们的总统那里获得财务透明度？

sentences.en: And what did the court ultimately say to that question?
sentences.zh: 法院最终对这个问题是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The court said, maybe not in so many words, but the thrust of the decisions was, sure, if they're relevant to the president's official conduct,
sentences.zh: 法院表示——也许没有用这么直接的词汇，但裁决的核心意思是——当然可以，如果它们与总统的官方行为相关的话，

sentences.en: the public is entitled to know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 公众有权知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Or if it's relevant to a criminal prosecution or investigation of the president or of one of his associates, sure, the public is entitled to that.
sentences.zh: 或者如果它与针对总统或其某个同僚的刑事起诉或调查有关，当然，公众有权知道。

sentences.en: But it can't be overbroad.
sentences.zh: 但范围不能过于宽泛。

sentences.en: It's got to be targeted and limited and sensible.
sentences.zh: 它必须是有针对性的、有限的且合乎情理的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And the second question is whether the president is entitled to protection from partisan attempts to dig into his financial records.
sentences.zh: 第二个问题是，总统是否有权免受出于党派动机企图挖掘其财务记录的行为的侵害。

sentences.en: So what did the ruling ultimately mean for that?
sentences.zh: 那么这一裁决最终对这一点意味着什么？

sentences.en: The ruling said in the criminal context,
sentences.zh: 裁决指出，在刑事背景下，

sentences.en: the court expected judges to make sure that politically motivated prosecutors weren't doing something unsavory and to protect the president from harassment.
sentences.zh: 法院期望法官确保出于政治动机的检察官没有做出什么不正当的事情，并保护总统免受骚扰。

sentences.en: And in the legislative context, the court also said that if there's a good enough, strong enough link between a legislative purpose and the need for this information, that, too,
sentences.zh: 而在立法背景下，法院也表示，如果在立法目的与获取该信息的需要之间存在足够好、足够强的联系，那么这也是

sentences.en: was acceptable, that presidents could be made to turn over information.
sentences.zh: 可以接受的，总统也可能被迫交出信息。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: what's interesting about your answers to this is that it feels like the principle that has been laid out in these decisions doesn't feel entirely tied to the result of them.
sentences.zh: 你对这些问题的回答有趣的地方在于，感觉这些裁决中所确立的原则似乎并不完全与它们的结果挂钩。

sentences.en: You know, for example, if the court is saying the public is entitled to information about the president and his finances,
sentences.zh: 你知道，举个例子，如果法院在说公众有权了解有关总统及其财务的信息，

sentences.en: then why are we living in a world where they won't see them?
sentences.zh: 那为什么我们生活在一个他们看不到这些信息的现实中呢？

sentences.en: Well, the court is not about timing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，法院关心的不是时间表。

sentences.en: The court is not about tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 法院关心的不是明天。

sentences.en: It's about principles and processes, and the legal system takes its time.
sentences.zh: 它关心的是原则和程序，而法律系统需要时间。

sentences.en: And I know we're all eager to see this information before the election.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们都急于在大选前看到这些信息。

sentences.en: And, of course, it could well inform the ability of citizens in a democracy to choose their leaders correctly.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，这很可能会有助于民主国家中的公民正确选择他们的领导人。

sentences.en: But that's not what the court is focused on.
sentences.zh: 但那并不是法院关注的焦点。

sentences.en: The court is focused on getting it right.
sentences.zh: 法院关注的焦点是把事情弄对。

sentences.en: And that will take time.
sentences.zh: 而那需要时间。

sentences.en: And as a practical matter, the amount of time it will take may make it much less politically salient.
sentences.zh: 而且从实际情况来看，它所需的时间可能会使其政治意义大大降低。

sentences.en: But this is not a decision about President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是一个关于特朗普总统的裁决。

sentences.en: This is a decision about the presidency.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于总统职位的裁决。

sentences.en: And the court has laid down some important markers on that.
sentences.zh: 而法院在这方面设定了一些重要的标杆。

sentences.en: Adam, reporter to reporter here.
sentences.zh: 亚当，同行之间交流一下。

sentences.en: Do you think we're ever going to see these documents?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们这辈子还能看到这些文件吗？

sentences.en: I mean, ever?
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的能看到吗？

sentences.en: I think it's probably more likely they see the light of day through good investigative journalism, including from The New York Times,
sentences.zh: 我认为，它们更有可能是通过出色的调查新闻（包括来自《纽约时报》的报道）重见天日，

sentences.en: than through these convoluted mechanisms of congressional subpoenas and grand jury subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 而不是通过国会传票和大陪审团传票这种曲折的机制。

sentences.en: That's not to say it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说绝无可能。

sentences.en: But they're more likely to see the light of day in any kind of timely fashion through reporting than through litigation.
sentences.zh: 但比起通过诉讼，它们更有可能以某种及时的方通过报道重见天日。

sentences.en: Thank you, Adam.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚当。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Supreme Court issued a separate ruling, finding that much of eastern Oklahoma, including most of Tulsa, falls within an Indian reservation,
sentences.zh: 周四，最高法院发布了一项单独的裁决，裁定俄克拉何马州东部的大部分地区（包括塔尔萨的大部分地区）属于印第安人保留地，

sentences.en: meaning that state authorities there cannot prosecute offenses involving Native Americans.
sentences.zh: 这意味着该州的执法机构不能起诉涉及美洲原住民的犯罪行为。

sentences.en: At issue in the case was whether Congress had officially eliminated a reservation when Oklahoma became a state in 1907.
sentences.zh: 该案争议的核心在于，当俄克拉何马州在1907年成为一个州时，国会是否正式取消了一个保留地。

sentences.en: The justices ruled that it had not.
sentences.zh: 大法官们裁定国会并未取消。

sentences.en: The 5-4 decision is one of the most consequential legal victories for Native Americans in decades.
sentences.zh: 这项5比4的裁决是几十年来美洲原住民获得的最具重大意义的法律胜利之一。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the World Health Organization formally acknowledged that droplets carrying the coronavirus, known as aerosols,
sentences.zh: 周四，世界卫生组织正式承认，携带冠状病毒的飞沫（被称为气溶胶），

sentences.en: can linger in the air within indoor spaces for long periods, raising the risk of infections.
sentences.zh: 可以在室内空间的空气中长时间滞留，从而增加感染风险。

sentences.en: The acknowledgment, which scientists said was long overdue, could complicate efforts to socially distance indoors.
sentences.zh: 科学家们表示这一承认早就该有了，它可能会让在室内保持社交距离的努力变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: At the same time, the WHO also acknowledged that seemingly healthy people can transmit the virus even when they don't have symptoms, a finding that the WHO had long resisted.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，世卫组织还承认，貌似健康的人即使没有症状也能传播病毒，这一发现在很长一段时间里遭到了世卫组织的抗拒。

sentences.en: The concept of symptomless spread was raised at least three months ago by a doctor in Germany, Camilla Roth, whose report on a patient there was widely dismissed by scientists,
sentences.zh: 无症状传播的概念至少在三个月前就被德国的一位医生卡米拉·罗斯提出，她关于当地一名病人的报告在很大程度上被科学家们所忽视，

sentences.en: including those at the WHO.
sentences.zh: 其中包括世卫组织的那些科学家。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎进来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人兴奋的权斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
